subject: Urban Planning
title: Brasília: A Capital Without a Soul
description: A quick win: understand Brasília: A Capital Without a Soul.

hook.text: Brasília was built from scratch in 41 months. From the air, it looks like an airplane. From the ground, it feels empty.

buildup.text: Oscar Niemeyer designed stunning buildings. Lúcio Costa planned wide boulevards. They forgot about people.

discovery.text: Superblocks separated residential from commercial zones. Walking anywhere takes forever. Streets have no life.

twist.text: Workers who built Brasília weren't allowed to live in it. They formed satellite cities on the outskirts — unplanned.

climax.text: Brasília is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Residents say it's beautiful to visit and terrible to live in.

punchline.text: Perfect from the sky. Lonely on the ground.

quiz.question: What is the main criticism of Brasília's urban design?
options: The buildings are poorly constructed and deteriorating
Separated zones and wide boulevards make it unwalkable and lifeless
The climate is too harsh for comfortable outdoor activity
